name: bubble-chat
description: Bubble Chat desktop app for Messenger and Zalo

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron "vite --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8443" "wait-on tcp:8443 && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= VITE_DEV_URL=http://localhost:8443 electron ."
scripts.build:mac: cross-env ELECTRON=1 vite build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.build:win: cross-env ELECTRON=1 vite build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.build:linux: cross-env ELECTRON=1 vite build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.build:all: cross-env ELECTRON=1 vite build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder -mw --publish never
scripts.electron:build: cross-env ELECTRON=1 vite build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --publish never
